name: cabal
description: Diplomacy with receipts. A Rust adjudicated, WebAssembly powered, Cloudflare hosted negotiation game.
author: Karthik Subramanian

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter @cabal/web build && pnpm --filter @cabal/web exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name playcabal --branch main
